description: Reference implementation: call public AIDP / OCI APIs from a custom code tool using an OCI API-key signer resolved at runtime from AIDP's Credential Store. No PEM files in the zip; no hardcoded keys in source.

tools.description: Demonstrates aidputils.secrets.get(...) + oci.signer.Signer(private_key_content=...). Validates the signer with op='whoami', then exercises the failing list_volumes endpoint with op='list_volumes'.

schema.name: op
schema.description: Which operation to run. 'whoami' proves the signer authenticates (404=authenticated-but-no-read-users-perm, 401=bad credential). 'list_catalogs' -> 'list_schemas' -> 'list_volumes'/'list_kbs' is a discovery chain against the public AIDP data plane (real API uses flat resources + query params, e.g. /volumes?catalogKey=..&schemaKey=..): each op returns keys you paste into the next. Start with list_catalogs to get real catalog keys (not display names).

schema.name: kb_key
schema.description: For op=get_kb: the knowledge base's hex key (e.g. 33076ca9d9fd49388562aefa48715caa), from op=list_kbs. Falls back to conf.kb_key.

schema.name: volume_key
schema.description: For op=list_files: the full dotted volume key catalog.schema.volume (e.g. construction_catalog.construction_schema.construction_documents), from op=list_volumes. Falls back to conf.volume_key.

schema.name: path
schema.description: For op=list_files: folder path inside the volume to list. Defaults to '/' (volume root). Pass a subfolder to descend.

schema.name: credential_name
schema.description: Display name of the SECRET_TOKEN credential in AIDP's Credential Store. Must have four secret keys: tenancy, user, fingerprint, private_key (PEM body, not a path). Leave blank to fall back to conf.credential_name.

schema.name: data_lake_ocid
schema.description: Data Lake OCID. Only used for op='list_volumes'. Falls back to conf.data_lake_ocid.

schema.name: catalog_key
schema.description: For list_schemas/list_tables/list_volumes/list_kbs: use the MASTER catalog key (the Hive Metastore that contains all catalogs — key ends in _HMS, from console: Master catalog -> Details -> Key), NOT a standard sub-catalog key. Schemas/tables/volumes/KBs are registered in the HMS; passing a standard sub-catalog key returns empty or 500. Falls back to conf.catalog_key.

schema.name: schema_key
schema.description: Fully-qualified schema key catalog.schema (e.g. construction_catalog.construction_schema), from the schema's Details -> Key in the console. Falls back to conf.schema_key.

auth.note: The agent runtime uses resource principal to call aidputils.secrets internally. The credential the tool then uses for downstream OCI calls is resolved per-invocation from the Credential Store — no permanent PEM in this zip.

credential_name.placeholder: Display name of the SECRET_TOKEN credential in AIDP
credential_name.help: Create the credential in AIDP → Settings → Credentials. Type: SECRET_TOKEN. Keys: tenancy / user / fingerprint / private_key.
